eq-ch01-stage-combine: Each stage combines the saved step-start state, the current state and the stage increment with the integrator weights $w_0, w_1, w_2$.
eq-ch01-stage-weight: An increment supplied in stage $s$ enters the end-of-step state with weight $w_2^{(s)}$ times the $w_1$ of every later stage.
eq-ch01-stage-upwind: A tracer's transfer through an $x_1$ face is the clamped dry-mass transfer times the upwind cell's tracer ratio.
eq-ch01-stage-transfer: The tracer increment of a cell is the net face transfer divided by the cell volume, so internal faces cancel in the column sum.
eq-ch01-stage-dry: A supplied dry-mass source carries tracers at the selected carry ratio.
eq-ch02-laws-increment: The flux-only stage increment is minus $\Delta t/V_i$ times the difference of area-weighted face fluxes.
eq-ch02-ideal-gas-pressure: Ideal gas: internal energy from total energy minus kinetic energy, then pressure, temperature and sound speed.
eq-ch02-ideal-moist-factors: The moist factors $f_\varepsilon$ (gas constant) and $f_\sigma$ (heat capacity) of a mixture relative to dry air.
eq-ch02-ideal-moist-energy: Ideal-moist internal energy and pressure, with the species reference energies removed before the pressure.
eq-ch02-ideal-moist-gamma: The ideal-moist adiabatic index at frozen composition: $\gamma = 1 + (\gamma_d - 1) f_\varepsilon / f_\sigma$.
eq-ch02-moist-mixture-speed: Moist-mixture isothermal sound speed from the compressibility factors, the mixture $\gamma$, and $c_s = \sqrt{\gamma}\,c_T$.
eq-ch02-moist-mixture-newton: Newton update of temperature from internal energy, with the volumetric heat capacity as derivative.
eq-ch02-moist-mixture-integral: Species internal energy for NASA-9 heat capacities, referenced to 300 K so the energy zero is unchanged.
eq-ch02-moist-mixture-rotor: Heat capacity of H2 from the variance of the rotational level energy (levels 0 to 40).
eq-ch02-aneos-gamma: The effective adiabatic index of a tabulated EOS from its sound speed, pressure and density.
eq-ch02-shallow-water-speed: Shallow water: the squared wave speed is the stored depth variable (gravity absorbed).
eq-ch02-consistency-affine: With constant heat capacities, internal energy density is affine in temperature at fixed partial densities.
eq-ch02-consistency-enthalpy: The species enthalpies plus kinetic energy, dry row included, sum to $E + p$.
eq-ch02-saturation-energy: Phase equilibrium at fixed volume and energy: reaction extents change concentrations, with non-negative results and fixed internal energy.
eq-ch03-globalgrid-slice: A block's faces are a consecutive slice of the one global face array, ghosts included.
eq-ch03-globalgrid-offset: The block's offset in the global array is the rounded quotient of its start by the cell width.
eq-ch03-cartesian-metric: Cartesian face areas and cell volume are products of the cell widths.
eq-ch03-sphpolar-metric: Exact spherical-polar face areas and cell volume of a cell.
eq-ch03-sphpolar-centroids: Spherical-polar cell centres are the volume centroids in $r$ and $\theta$.
eq-ch03-sphpolar-src1: The radial geometric source: $\langle r^{-1} \rangle$ times centrifugal momentum flux plus twice the pressure.
eq-ch03-sphpolar-facep: With face pressures in the flux, the pressure source cancels the flux divergence's pressure part exactly.
eq-ch03-sphpolar-angmom: The $x_1$ divergence of $m_2$ plus its curvature term in angular-momentum form, which telescopes in $r$.
eq-ch03-gnomonic-angle: Cosine and sine of the angle between the two tangent directions of the gnomonic grid.
eq-ch03-gnomonic-solidangle: The exact solid angle of a gnomonic cell as a signed corner sum of arctangents.
eq-ch03-gnomonic-volume: Exact cubed-sphere $x_1$ face area and cell volume from the solid angle.
eq-ch03-gnomonic-lower: Lowering and raising tangential velocity components on the non-orthogonal gnomonic grid.
eq-ch03-facemoments-moment: Second central moment of a radial face's area measure about its centroid.
eq-ch03-facemoments-shift: Exact shift between the radial face-area centroid and the volume centroid, $h^2/(12x^m)$ to leading order.
eq-ch03-layouts-rank: Cubed-sphere global block rank (face-major Morton order) and its split into process and local index.
eq-ch03-exchange-corner: A synthesised corner ghost is the mean of the two adjacent ghost strips.
eq-ch03-csinterp-slide: The along-edge angle of a ghost cell centre as seen from the neighbouring panel.
eq-ch03-csinterp-weights: Cross-panel ghost value by linear interpolation in the source panel's cell abscissa.
eq-ch03-thetacopy-face: The limited face flux is the donor cell's factor $\Theta$ times the flux, so both sides must hold the same $\Theta$.
eq-ch03-x1seams-average: Both blocks at an $x_1$ seam use the mean of their two seam fluxes, so the column sum telescopes.
eq-ch03-synctype-matrix: One matrix per ghost position folds raising, panel rotation and lowering for a conserved velocity strip.
eq-ch04-divergence-exact: The finite-volume balance: the rate of change of a cell integral equals minus the outward boundary flux, exactly.
eq-ch04-plm-slope: The PLM slope is the harmonic mean of the two one-sided differences, zero at an extremum.
eq-ch04-weno-weights: WENO nonlinear weights from the linear weights and the smoothness indicators, with $\varepsilon = 10^{-6}$.
eq-ch04-riemann-frame: The normal momentum row of direction `dim` is $\mathrm{IPR} - \mathrm{dim}$; the tangential rows follow by cycling.
eq-ch04-lmars-face: LMARS face velocity and pressure: centred averages plus acoustic corrections from the other variable's jump.
eq-ch04-sphsrc-src1: The spherical-polar radial momentum source is the centrifugal term of the tangential velocities.
eq-ch04-fluxcov-identity: The cell average of a product is the product of averages plus $h^2 f' g'/12$, to $O(h^4)$.
eq-ch04-fluxcov-dF: The face-flux correction: a covariance term plus a centroid-offset term on curved grids.
eq-ch04-x1masscov-gap: The stored velocity $m_1/\rho$ differs from the cell-average velocity by $h^2 \rho' w'/(12\rho)$.
eq-ch05-wbx1-split: Well-balanced $x_1$ reconstruction works on perturbations about the hydrostatic reference and restores it at faces.
eq-ch05-wbx1-rest: The discrete rest state: cell pressure equals the reference pressure plus one constant per column.
eq-ch05-refkernel-scan: Reference face pressures are scanned down the column, each face adding $g\bar\rho_i\Delta x_{1,i}$.
eq-ch05-refkernel-anchor: On one block the top face pressure is the top cell's pressure extrapolated isothermally by half a cell.
eq-ch05-refkernel-pref: On a uniform grid the reference cell pressure is the average of the quintic through six face pressures.
eq-ch05-refkernel-logmean: On a non-uniform grid the reference cell pressure is the log-mean of the two face pressures.
eq-ch05-refkernel-dens: Reference cell and face densities from the reference pressures and a binomially smoothed $\rho/p$ ratio.
eq-ch05-refkernel-offset: The face-density offset of the default reference is $O(\Delta x_1^2)$, with the stated leading term.
eq-ch05-wallclamp-repeat: Repeating the wall value of $\rho/p$ past a wall biases the smoothed ratio in the first two cells by $3a/8$ and $a/16$.
eq-ch05-wallclamp-cont: Past a clamped wall the $\rho/p$ ratio is continued linearly or geometrically, by the sign of its slope.
eq-ch05-seam-relay: Below an $x_1$ seam, a block's top anchor is the bottom-face pressure of the block above.
eq-ch05-hsmode-force: The hydrostatic mode adds the cell's own face-pressure difference, weighted by $1 - n_h$, to momentum and energy.
eq-ch05-balcol-iter: One `balance_column` sweep: set each cell pressure to its reference plus the top-cell gauge, at fixed $p/\rho$.
eq-ch05-balcol-res: `balance_column` stops when the largest balance residual, scaled by $\rho g \Delta x_1$, is below `rtol`.
eq-ch05-wbref4-dref: Fourth-order reference cell density from a five-point filter $(-1, 4, 10, 4, -1)/16$ of $\rho/p$.
eq-ch05-wbref4-cubic: At a clamped wall the two values past the wall are cubic extrapolations of the four nearest owned cells.
eq-ch05-wbref4-face: Reference face density as the derivative of the quartic through the cumulative cell mass at five faces.
eq-ch05-wbref4-pnu: On a non-uniform grid the reference cell pressure is the three-point Gauss average of the cubic through four face pressures.
eq-ch05-x1cent-defect: On spherical-polar grids the $r^2$-weighted cell mean differs from the plain mean by $\delta_i q'$, with $\delta_i \approx h^2/(6\bar r)$.
eq-ch05-x1cent-conv: Plain cell means recovered from $r^2$-weighted means by a five-cell stencil exact for quartics.
eq-ch05-x1cent-source: The radial pressure source as the $r$-weighted integral of the quintic through six face pressures.
eq-ch05-oneoverr-favre: The Favre-mean velocity differs from the plain mean by a covariance term and a centroid-offset term.
eq-ch05-legacy-copy: The legacy wall-face copy sets the outer pressure and density state equal to the inner one.
eq-ch06-dwork-template: Exact gravity work in a cell equals minus the rate of change of its potential energy minus the potential-energy flux difference.
eq-ch06-dwork-booked: The booked gravity work is defined from a chosen discrete potential energy, so $E$ plus that energy is conserved.
eq-ch06-dwork-continuity: Discrete $x_1$ continuity: the cell mass tendency is minus the difference of area-weighted total mass fluxes.
eq-ch06-dwork-face: The face form of the gravity work, from potential differences between the centroid and the two faces.
eq-ch06-dwork-faceerr: Error of the face form against the exact work: $O(h^2)$, with two extra curvature terms on spherical-polar grids.
eq-ch06-dwork-pe4: A cell's exact potential energy is $V(\bar\rho\phi - g\sigma^2\partial_1\rho)$ to $O(h^4)$.
eq-ch06-dwork-variance: Variance of $x_1$ about the volume centroid, for Cartesian and spherical-polar cells.
eq-ch06-dwork-slope: The density slope at the centroid from the quadratic through neighbouring cell averages.
eq-ch06-dwork-pe: The corrected discrete potential energy, accurate to $O(h^4)$.
eq-ch06-dwork-d: Corrected-PE gravity work: the face form plus $g\sigma^2$ times the centroid slope of the density tendency.
eq-ch06-dwork-ped-change: Under the corrected scheme, $E + \mathrm{PE}_d$ changes per stage by $g\sum V\sigma^2 s[\Delta\rho]$.
eq-ch06-dwork-order: The corrected gravity work is fourth-order accurate in every cell, wall cells included.
eq-ch06-dwork-uniform: On a uniform Cartesian grid the corrected work is a five-face stencil in the interior and a three-face one at the wall.
eq-ch06-dwork-vicrow: Row $i$ of the vertical implicit block-tridiagonal system, with the stage step $\Delta t_c = w_2\Delta t$.
eq-ch06-dwork-lumped: The end-cell third weight of the centroid slope is lumped onto the neighbour, so the system stays tridiagonal.
eq-ch06-dwork-couple: The implicit energy row gains a coupling to the mass unknowns from the corrected-PE term.
eq-ch06-dwork-energyrow: The implicit solve books, in the energy row, the gravity work of the mass it moves.
eq-ch06-dwork-remainder: After redistribution, the remainder between the full and lumped slopes of the moved mass is added to energy.
eq-ch08-theta-def: The positivity factor $\theta_i$ limits a cell's total outflow to its content over the step.
eq-ch08-carry-dm: The mass withheld at a face by the limiter is $(1 - \theta_d)F$.
eq-ch09-framework-stage: One stage increment: minus the flux divergence plus the sum of the registered forcing sources, times $\Delta t$.
eq-ch09-user-add: User stage forcings add their `hydro_du` to the native stage increment.
eq-ch09-coriolis-force: The Coriolis momentum increment $-2\Delta t\,\Omega \times m$, which does no work.
eq-ch09-coriolis-sph: A Cartesian rotation vector projected onto the local spherical-polar basis.
eq-ch09-viscosity-flux: Viscous momentum flux (Newtonian stress) and energy flux (viscous work plus Fourier conduction).
eq-ch09-viscosity-stencil: Diffusion face derivatives: normal difference, averaged tangential differences and the two-cell face mean.
eq-ch09-viscosity-dt: The explicit diffusion time-step limit $h_{\min}^2/(2 n_{\mathrm{dim}} K)$.
eq-ch09-viscosity-adiabat: Conduction heats a resting adiabat at $\kappa g^2 c_v/(R c_p^2 T)$.
eq-ch09-wallcoef-extrap: The diffusion coefficient at a wall face is linearly extrapolated from the two nearest cells.
eq-ch09-x1profile-mp: Mean-of-products versus product-of-means face coefficients, which differ by a quarter of the product of the two jumps.
eq-ch09-heating-body: Body heating adds $\Delta t\,\dot T\rho c_v$ to energy in cells within the pressure window.
eq-ch09-heating-flux: A boundary heat flux is spread uniformly over the $d$ cells next to the boundary.
eq-ch09-relax-temp: Bottom temperature relaxation of the bottom cell's energy towards `btemp` at time scale $\tau$.
eq-ch09-relax-face: With `at-face`, the relaxation target is the temperature extrapolated to the bottom face, with a matching gain.
eq-ch09-relax-velo: Bottom velocity relaxation of covariant momentum towards the target velocity.
eq-ch09-relax-comp: Bottom composition relaxation towards the target mass fractions at fixed total density.
eq-ch09-sponge-drag: Sponge-layer Rayleigh drag with a $\sin^2$ profile of the scaled distance.
eq-ch10-satadj-state: Total density, internal energy density and mass fractions formed from the conserved state before saturation adjustment.
eq-ch10-borrow-split: A negative condensate is repaid from its parent vapours, in proportion to their stoichiometric mass shares.
eq-ch10-fixvapor-flatten: A negative vapour window in a column is rewritten at a uniform ratio to dry air, conserving its mass.
eq-ch10-kinetics-step: One linearised backward-Euler step of the kinetics rates for the concentration change.
eq-ch10-kinetics-extent: The equilibrium extent of an evaporating condensate, in a form without cancellation.
eq-ch10-tracer-bound: A tracer flux with an upper bound $b$ is limited by applying the positivity limiter to $bF_d - F_n$.
eq-ch10-sed-stokes: The Stokes terminal velocity of a condensate with the Cunningham slip correction.
eq-ch10-sed-viscosity: The Chapman-Enskog viscosity of a Lennard-Jones gas used in the sedimentation velocity.
eq-ch11-reflecting-parity: Reflecting wall ghosts: even components mirrored, normal velocity mirrored with a sign change.
eq-ch11-periodic-copy: Periodic ghosts copy the matching owned cells from the other end, an exact permutation.
eq-ch11-extrapolation-copy: Extrapolation ghosts repeat the nearest owned cell.
eq-ch11-outflow-modes: Outflow characteristic variables: the two acoustic combinations and the entropy perturbation.
eq-ch11-outflow-inverse: Inverse of the characteristic split after the incoming modes are set to zero.
eq-ch11-outflow-admissible: The outflow ghost state is the background plus one scaled perturbation that keeps it admissible.
eq-ch11-exchange-corner: A corner ghost is the average of the two adjacent edge strips.
eq-ch11-solids-dp: Dynamic-programming update of the minimum flip cost for rectifying a solid mask with minimum run lengths.
eq-ch11-solids-closure: Reflecting closure of a fluid face against a solid in the implicit system, folded into the diagonal block.
eq-ch11-wb-continuation: Wall continuation of the hydrostatic $\rho/p$ ratio, linear in $\chi$ or in $\log\chi$ by the slope sign.
eq-ch11-wb-parity: Wall ghosts mirror the pressure and density perturbations about the hydrostatic reference.
eq-ch12-wb-reference-filter: The fourth-order cell density reference: the reference pressure times the five-point filtered $\rho/p$ ratio.
eq-ch12-centroid-pressure: Integration by parts splits the radial pressure acceleration into the face pressure flux and an $r$-weighted source.
eq-ch12-flux-covariance-energy: The lateral energy-flux correction: an enthalpy covariance term minus a face-centroid shift term.
eq-ch12-mass-covariance-mean: The plain velocity mean is the density-weighted mean minus $h^2\rho' v_1'/(12\rho)$.
eq-ch12-radial-exact-budget: The corrected potential energy and its change, both linear in density through the centroid slope.
eq-ch14-launch-rank: Global block rank from process rank and local block index, and back.
eq-ch14-msgmatch-tag: Exchange message tag from the sync id, local block, buffer and variable index; it is one to one.
eq-ch14-restart-next: On resume, an output's next time is clamped to one interval ahead; a new output joins the grid at or below the restored time.
eq-ch14-schedule-moments: Time-weighted running mean and deviation of output statistics (weighted Welford recurrence).
